text:
ana-eng: paging — noticed staging log-pusher started sending debug logs to s3://redwood-staging-debug-uploads unexpectedly at 2026-03-16T14:12:03Z. also saw honeytoken file GETs from 3 distinct IPs (45.33.12.7, 45.33.55.2, 45.33.199.10).

sre-pagerbot: Pager duty alert created: auth spike + unusual s3 uploads. Incident assigned to oncall: mike-ops. Incident ID INC-2719.

mike-ops: i'm on it. can someone paste a small sample of the request/headers?

ana-eng: here's a redacted snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T14:11:58Z] DEBUG logpush upload to s3://redwood-staging-debug-uploads/2026-03-16/req.log size=4.2kb
GET /honeytoken.txt HTTP/1.1
Host: redwood-staging-debug-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com
Authorization: Bearer STAGING_SVC_TOKEN=eyJhbGci...REDACTED
X-Forwarded-For: 45.33.12.7
```

jess-sec: tagging security — possible leaked staging tokens. Any customer data in those debug dumps?

leo-support: quick scan — this looks limited to staging bucket only. no prod buckets observed. the debug payload includes environment variables that reference STAGING_DB_URL but no PROD keys.

ops-jen: blocking offending IPs at edge now. applied temporary WAF IP set: 45.33.0.0/16. command run:
```
aws wafv2 update-ip-set --name "block-suspect-ips" --addresses "45.33.12.7/32" "45.33.55.2/32" "45.33.199.10/32"
```

mike-ops: mitigation plan: 1) rotate svcacct-stager tokens immediately 2) revoke any active STS sessions for staging 3) scrub bucket and move debug uploads to quarantine 4) remove debug flag from logpush deployment 5) postmortem + IAM audit. starting rotation now.

mike-ops: running rotation script:
```
./scripts/rotate_service_token.sh --service svcacct-stager --env staging
=> rotated token id: svc-stager-rot-20260316-03
=> invalidated 12 active sessions
```

mike-ops: scrubbed bucket, copied suspect objects to quarantine s3://redwood-security-quarantine/inc-2719/, set bucket ACL to private and disabled public list. deployed config change to set LOGPUSH_UPLOAD=false in staging.

jess-sec: legal/compliance pinged for guidance. @legal oncall please review whether we need to notify customers. no evidence of prod exposure but keep legal in loop.

leo-support: no customer-facing impact identified. monitoring for honeytoken hits and abnormal auth rates.

ana-eng: confirmed no further honeytoken GETs after IP blocks and token rotation. will close once postmortem tasks assigned.

jess-sec: postmortem owner: jess-sec. action items: audit staging IAM policies, remove debug in CI, add honeytoken alert (threshold 3 hits), tighten bucket ACLs, add runbook step to rotate staging tokens on honeytoken hit.

sre-pagerbot: INCIDENT CLOSED. Duration ~15m. See INC-2719 for full notes and artifact links.
